title: Recurrence picker
description: Pressed day keys author a weekly rule and illuminate its next three weeks.
useCase: Configure a repeat schedule with a compact preview of the dates it will affect.
interaction: Select weekdays, choose a weekly interval and toggle repeating. The 21-day strip follows the rule.
reducedMotion: Finite transitions become immediate under reduced motion and keyboard input. Host pause disables controls; any owned drag is cancelled.
limitations: Local illustrative schedule anchored to Monday, October 12, 2026; no timezone, DST or recurrence-service integration. Empty day sets are allowed with an explicit accessible prompt.
look: Off-white card on cool grey: sage switch, a recessed tray of raised day keys with selected ones burnt orange, and a row of date tiles.
motion: Pressed day keys sink 3 px and settle 1 px low in orange (160 ms ease-out); the switch thumb slides in 180 ms; matching date tiles recolour in 150 ms.
adapt: Selection state is `days`, `interval` and `enabled`, and the 21 `.occurrences` tiles derive `data-on` from them; press depth and timing are the `.days button` rules in the inline style. Replace `DAYS`, the hard-coded start date and the summary text with your scheduler.
